jobs.description_text: ABOUT ACT There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. ROLE - Lead application architecture and engineering across backend, mobile and desktop platforms - Design systems for AI-powered workflows, including orchestration, state management, retries and failure recovery - Build and review backend services, APIs and integrations that connect AI systems with product features - Make technical decisions on system design, performance, reliability, security and infrastructure - Lead a small team of senior engineers through technical design, code reviews and engineering guidance - Work with ML and product teams to integrate AI capabilities into production applications - Improve system performance, monitoring, testing and production reliability REQUIREMENTS - 8+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of production applications - Strong backend engineering expertise, including APIs, databases, distributed systems and cloud infrastructure - Experience designing and scaling systems across multiple services or application platforms - Hands-on experience integrating LLMs or AI-powered features into production applications - Ability to make architecture decisions, review code and resolve difficult engineering problems - Experience leading senior engineers through technical design, code reviews and mentorship - Strong understanding of system performance, concurrency, reliability and production monitoring NICE TO HAVE - Experience building AI agents, orchestration systems or multi-step workflows - Experience developing applications across web, mobile and desktop platforms - Experience with messaging, email, collaboration or productivity applications - Experience leading engineering teams in early-stage technology companies

FOCUS - Build end-to-end product features across frontend, backend, and AI integrations - Design agent workflows that handle planning, tool use, failure, and recovery across multiple steps. - Integrate LLMs, memory, and external tools into systems that behave reliably under real-world conditions - Design real-time AI interactions with streaming, partial results, and tight latency constraints - Improve system reliability, observability, and fallback mechanisms - Collaborate closely with ML, backend, and product teams to ship features end-to-end - Continuously iterate based on real usage and failure modes IDEAL EXPERIENCES - Strong experience in full stack engineering (frontend + backend) - Solid understanding of system design and API architecture - Experience working with LLMs, RAG systems, or AI-powered applications - Ability to handle ambiguity and make pragmatic engineering decisions - Strong ownership - able to take features from idea to production - Comfort working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements OUTCOMES - Own and ship AI-native product features that move beyond chat into persistent, goal-driven workflows - Design and deploy agent workflows that reliably complete multi-step tasks across tools and sessions - Reduce latency and improve responsiveness of AI interactions while maintaining output quality - Build robust fallback and recovery mechanisms for LLM and tool failures in production environments - Improve the success rate and reliability of AI-driven workflows through iteration, evaluation, and monitoring - Establish patterns and abstractions for integrating LLMs, memory, and external tools into scalable product systems - Contribute to a product experience where AI feels proactive, consistent, and dependable over time TECH STACK - Next.js - Python - NodeJs - Pytorch - OpenAI / Anthropic / open-source LLMs - SQl & noSQL - Kubernetes - Docker HOW WE WORK The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product INTERVIEW PROCESS If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT DOIT We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. THE ROLE We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for Doit's AI Finance Agent. This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers. WHAT WILL YOU BUILD - Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys. - Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile. - Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release. - Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability. - Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch. - Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Strong native iOS experience using Swift. - Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users. - Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns. - Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens. - Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality. - Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar. THE BAR We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system. THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR - Engineers who only want fully defined tickets. - Developers who build screens without caring about user experience. - People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance. - Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment. - People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution. LOCATION This role is remote, but candidates must be based in China. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in China. LANGUAGE English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. INTERVIEW PROCESS Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT We are reimagining the phone. AI phones need to be proactive, intuitive, intelligent and low cost. This is a mission critical for rest of the world to adopt intelligence. There are over 5 billion people using everyday applications such as email, messaging, notes, tasks, and calendars, yet most are not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications and devices that bring intelligence into daily conversations, coordination and workflows, with minimal prompting. Focus: Designing and implementing the security and privacy architecture for the AI-native phone, ensuring AI agents can safely access user data, interact with applications, and execute actions across the operating system. Unlike conventional mobile application security, this role needs to consider the additional risks introduced by AI agents having access to personal context, system services, and application-level actions. RESPONSIBILITIES - Design the overall security and privacy architecture for the AI-native phone. - Define permission models and access boundaries for AI agents interacting with user data and system services. - Design secure mechanisms for AI access to messages, contacts, calendars, notifications, camera, microphone, location and other sensitive information. - Implement appropriate sandboxing and isolation for agent execution. - Define authentication, authorization and access-control mechanisms for AI tools and application integrations. - Ensure users have control over what information AI can access and what actions it can execute. - Implement audit logging and user-visible activity tracking for AI access and actions. - Design secure storage, encryption, data retention and deletion mechanisms for personal data and memory. - Identify and mitigate AI-specific security risks, including prompt injection, malicious applications, data exfiltration and unauthorized tool execution. - Review Android permission models, privileged system access, SELinux policies and system-level security boundaries. - Work closely with Android/AOSP, Agent Runtime, Context & Memory and Applied ML teams to ensure security is built into the architecture rather than added later. - Conduct security assessments, threat modeling and penetration testing for system-level AI capabilities. REQUIREMENTS - Strong experience in mobile security, Android security, application security or systems security. - Deep understanding of Android security architecture, including application sandboxing, permissions, SELinux, Binder IPC and privileged system services. - Experience designing authentication, authorization and access-control systems. - Strong understanding of encryption, secure storage, key management and data protection. - Experience with security threat modeling, vulnerability assessment and penetration testing. - Understanding of privacy-by-design principles, data minimization and user consent. - Ability to work across Android platform, backend and AI agent architectures. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with AOSP security customization or Android platform security. - Experience securing system-level applications or privileged Android services. - Experience with AI agent security, prompt injection, tool-use security and LLM data leakage. - Experience with mobile device security, Trusted Execution Environment (TEE), hardware-backed keystores and secure boot. - Experience with privacy engineering for products handling sensitive personal information. - Experience building permission and approval systems for autonomous agents.
